searchLog: Second consecutive day of a total WebFetch outage in this session: every fetch attempt returned HTTP 403, including Ashby/Greenhouse job-board JSON (OpenAI, Cohere, Together AI, Reflection AI), company career pages (Databricks, Anthropic Greenhouse posting), and neutral control URLs with no bot-protection (example.com, en.wikipedia.org). The only URL that succeeded all session was raw.githubusercontent.com, which is useless for job postings. Checked the agent-proxy status diagnostic ($HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status) — proxy itself reports enabled with zero recent relay failures, so this looks like a WebFetch-tool-specific restriction rather than a network-level outage; not something fixable from inside this session. WebSearch worked fine (returned OpenAI FDE role-family results) but per the honesty rules a search snippet is not sufficient to confirm a posting is open now, eligible, and free — that requires loading the real page, which was not possible. Rather than include anything unverified, this run reports zero opportunities, matching yesterday's (2026-08-05) outcome for the same reason. Recommend investigating why WebFetch is broken for this scheduled session before the next run, since two days straight is now a pattern, not a blip.
